lines.text: The Spirit led Jesus into the wilderness to be tempted by the devil, and He fasted forty days and forty nights.
The tempter told Jesus to turn stones into bread, but Jesus answered that man shall not live on bread alone.
The devil set Jesus on the pinnacle of Jerusalem's walls and told Him to throw Himself down, but Jesus refused.
The devil showed Jesus all the kingdoms of the world from a high mountain and offered them if Jesus would stop speaking about God.

wrong_details.wrong: if Jesus would stop speaking about God
wrong_details.true: if Jesus would fall down and worship him

lines.text: Jesus told Satan to worship the Lord your God and serve Him only, and then the devil left and angels ministered to Him.
